List (3 of 3 items, style=ordered)
Source: https://docs.example.com/gateway/upgrade#16-to-17
Source Name: gateway-docs
Location: Upgrade guide > 1.6 to 1.7

[1] 1. Back up the gateway configuration with `kubectl get configmap gateway-config -o yaml > backup.yaml`.
[2] 2. Install the gateway Helm chart in version 1.7.0.
[3] 3. Check that every gateway pod reports `Ready` with `kubectl get pods -l app=gateway`.
